audit.whatIsWrong: Elastic Slingshot is named as the pivot of every stage but its cooldown appears nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9. Twenty-one seconds at rank 1 is the longest gap in the lane and it is simultaneously his only engage and his only escape — the whole matchup is 'is E up?', which you cannot answer without the number.
audit.corrected: 21s at rank 1 now appears in the level 6 spike, both wants lines, whys[5] and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game spike blamed 'his durable AoE body' generically.
audit.why: Unstable Matter deals a percentage of your maximum health as MAGIC damage every 5 seconds inside 350 range — that is why stacking MR is the wrong answer against him and why the fix is spacing, not resistances. Let's Bounce knocks up on each of its four bounces.
audit.corrected: Late spike now names Unstable Matter's max-health damage and Let's Bounce's repeated knockups.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] claimed Twilight Shroud goes untargetable 'breaking his Q tether', which asserts a targeting interaction Riot's text does not settle.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud establishes that Akali cannot be SELECTED by enemy spells and attacks. Stretching Strikes is a thrown grab and Unstable Matter is an area burst centred on Zac — neither needs to select you, so the shroud cannot be promised as an answer to them. The reliable counterplay is spacing: Unstable Matter only reaches 350 units.
audit.corrected: Replaced the untargetable claim with the 350-range spacing rule, which is verifiable from the kit.

edits.before: Akali pokes freely with the long-range fan of Five Point Strike while Zac (short-range Q tether, melee W) can't trade back — but his blob passive heals the chip, so you can't actually push him out.
edits.after: Akali pokes freely with the long fan of Five Point Strike while Zac's Q grab is short and Unstable Matter only reaches 350 — but Cell Division blobs heal the chip back, so bring anti-heal.

edits.before: R online: bait or wait out Zac's E charge, then E-flip onto him and two-cast Perfect Execution — the second dash executes on his missing health before his slow body can reposition.
edits.after: R online: bait or wait out Elastic Slingshot, 21s at rank 1, then E-flip onto him and two-cast Perfect Execution — the second dash executes on his missing health before he can reposition.

edits.before: Your Lich Bane / Rocketbelt spike is the cleanest all-in: E-Q-Mark auto-R on an isolated Zac caught with no E to slingshot away folds him before his blobs reform.
edits.after: Your Lich Bane / Rocketbelt spike is the cleanest all-in: E-Q-Mark auto-R on a Zac caught with Elastic Slingshot down folds him before his blobs reform.

edits.before: Zac's window: a full-build Elastic Slingshot from fog flings him onto your backline, his R knock-up chains into Q, and his durable AoE body shrugs off your single-target burst.
edits.after: Zac's window: a full-build Elastic Slingshot from fog flings him onto your backline, Let's Bounce knocks up on every bounce, and Unstable Matter's max-health magic ignores your MR.

edits.before: Bait or wait out his Elastic Slingshot charge, then E-flip in and dump your full combo while his only engage and escape tool is on cooldown
edits.after: Bait or wait out Elastic Slingshot, 21s at rank 1, then E-flip in and dump the full combo while his only engage and escape is down

edits.before: Drop Twilight Shroud to go untargetable mid-trade, breaking his Q tether and resetting any fight he opens
edits.after: Reposition out of Unstable Matter's 350 range between casts — it lands every 5s and scales on your max health

edits.before: Sustain through your Five Point Strike chip by walking over his Cell Division blobs, grinding the lane back to even
edits.after: Sustain through your Five Point Strike chip by walking over Cell Division blobs — anti-heal is what stops it

edits.before: Hold Elastic Slingshot as a peel/escape so that when you E-flip in at 6 he slings out of your R execute window
edits.after: Hold Elastic Slingshot as a peel tool so when you E-flip in at 6 he slings out of your R execute window

edits.before: Zac out-sustains the chip: every Cell Division blob he walks over heals the damage you dealt, so your poke can't push him out or convert to a kill.
edits.after: Zac out-sustains the chip: every Cell Division blob he walks over heals what you dealt, so bring anti-heal or the poke never converts.

edits.before: Shroud his E — build MR, Q-poke him. Akali wins the Elastic Slingshot cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bait his slingshot — anti-heal the blobs, Q-poke. Akali wins those 21s windows.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zac Elastic Slingshot, 21s at rank 1: matchup-defining — his only engage AND escape, so bait it. - Unstable Matter, 5s: max-health magic inside 350. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His engage. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only engage and escape, 21s at rank 1. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Your Lich Bane / Rocketbelt spike one-shots a Zac caught with his Elastic Slingshot down and no way to peel himself — your cleanest all-in window.
edits.after: Your Lich Bane / Rocketbelt spike one-shots a Zac caught with Elastic Slingshot down at 21s rank 1, with no way to peel himself out.
